bio_en: Vahan Hambardzumian was born at the end of the 19th century in Kovtun near Sebastia, the birthplace of Murad, whom he revered. He belonged to the 'middle generation' of the ARF whose studies after 1908 were shattered by the war of 1914. During the Republic of Armenia he took part in building the state, and in summer 1920 came to Paris from Yerevan with a diplomatic passport as courier of the government's instructions. He graduated in law in Paris in 1923, ran a small restaurant that became a meeting place for students, served in ARF bodies in 1934-38, and died in 1964.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium.
